0022600200.text: The Celtics come into their 10th game of the season at 7-2, second in the East and second in the Atlantic, one game behind the division lead, while the Bucks are 1-8, 15th in the East and fifth in the Central, 5.5 games back, and have lost five straight. Boston is 2-2 on the road, and Milwaukee is 1-4 at home. Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision for Boston, while Gary Trent Jr. is also day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision for Milwaukee. The Celtics lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-102 win in Boston on November 4, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
